comparison.objective: Locate a bracket on one round pin and one diamond pin with the diamond-pin flats facing the round pin.
comparison.physical_skill: Two-feature registration, orientation control, and close-tolerance placement over locating pins.
comparison.success_condition: Bracket located on both correctly oriented pins; seating and alignment tolerances are not given.
comparison.reason: This is precision peg registration/insertion. The candidate starts with inserts already installed and tests coaxial tool stabilization, transient impact, notch fracture, coil retention, and fragment recovery. No spec versions were provided.
